name: cortico-world-titanfall2-assistant
description: Cortico World for the Titanfall 2 campaign: Coo rides along as BT with live intel on the pilot, BT and hostiles, fires BT's missiles, smoke and sonar, and speaks in BT's voice and subtitles, through a Northstar mod and a sidecar.
author: Phantivia

zh.description: 让 Coo 接入泰坦陨落 2 单人战役里的 BT:实时掌握铁驭、BT 和敌人的情报并提醒玩家，主动发射 BT 的多目标飞弹、电烟幕和声纳脉冲，用游戏里的 BT 字幕和 VoxCPM2 复刻的 BT 声音说话。经 Northstar 模组与 sidecar 进程连接。游戏需自备。仅 Windows。

en.description: Puts Coo into BT in the Titanfall 2 campaign: live intel on the pilot, BT and hostiles with call-outs, BT's multi-target missiles, electric smoke and sonar pulse on demand, and BT's in-game subtitles with a VoxCPM2 clone of BT's voice. Connects through a Northstar mod and a sidecar process. Bring your own copy of the game. Windows only.
